correctness.rationale: For all m>=2 and all strictly positive c_i,d,B, the centered Rayleigh vector gives lambda_2 <= B/K for every asymmetric feasible allocation. The proposed strictly positive weights spend exactly B and solve Lx=(B/K)x. The even sector has nonzero spectral values at least min_i w_i>B/K, while the odd sector ground-state squares show its smallest eigenvalue equals B/K with simple eigenvector. Equality in the Rayleigh bound forces both individual weights of every pair and then the central weight, establishing unique global optimality. `verify.py` independently confirms 108 exact rational certificates, 120 spectra and 1440 asymmetric competitors.

value.rationale: A mirror-priced double-star is a natural pair of modular star networks coupled by an expensive/cheap inter-hub link. Unlike the previously evaluated uniform-cost case, arbitrary m-dimensional positive pendant price vectors require a nontrivial resource allocation for each edge. The exact unique price-to-weight map and inverse-square-root marginal law allow immediate design and rigorous sensitivity interpretation; no paper-sized extension is needed.
